title: The book’s notes

nodes.title: B down to D, then the octave
nodes.body: The book begins on B, three fingers down, because three holes seal before six do. Hear each note, then find it. If low D will not seal, find G and add fingers until it does. C♯ is every hole open: thumbs behind, the little finger steadying the tube. The octave D is the same six holes and more air. Another way leaves only the top hole open. Squeaks are part of finding the harder air.
nodes.high_d_body: You know the notes. On this tube the pads cover the holes, not the tips. The order is still B down to D, then the octave.

source: The order is the book’s. The notes and the pictures are ours. Low D is already known.
